budgets.title: Start with a budget that feels right.
budgets.body: Pick your budget and see the item count upfront. Celebration curates the products inside each hamper for you.

products.title: We choose the gift mix for you.
products.body: Products are curated according to the selected budget, occasion and availability.

builder.title: Your hamper, ready in 3 simple steps.
builder.body: Choose a budget, add delivery details and pay securely. Celebration curates the products inside your hamper.

budget.title: 1. What budget are you thinking?
budget.body: Pick a budget first. Each option shows exactly how many items will be included.

details.title: 2. Add the final details
details.body: Tell us who it’s for and when you need it. We’ll use this to curate, prepare and deliver it right.

message: What should we write on the card?

summary.note: Celebration selects the product mix according to your budget, occasion and availability. The item count shown for your tier stays fixed; presentation may vary slightly.

payment.title: 3. Review & pay
payment.body: Pay the shown amount via UPI. Your order starts after payment verification.
payment.successBody: We’ll start processing after payment verification.

promise.title: Clear from payment to delivery.
promise.body: You’ll know what happens next at every stage — from payment verification to packing and shipping.

cta.title: Still deciding what to send?
cta.body: Choose a budget and tell us a little about them. We’ll curate the hamper for you.
